subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR remain blocked until real embedded-agent proof demonstrates the internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths while maintainers choose it against the broader open candidate?
rationale: The repository requires real behavior proof for external PRs, and this diff changes session-state prompt semantics that focused helper tests and green CI do not fully settle.

options.title: Require runtime proof first
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run shows stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Pause for canonical strategy
options.body: Pause or later close this branch if maintainers choose the broader preserve-as-context repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from an embedded-agent run shows stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.
